# QuickNav - Open Source Directory

QuickNav is an open-source, fast, and customizable navigation directory. It allows users to easily manage, search, and categorize their favorite websites and resources.

## Features
- Search engine integration (Google, Bing, Baidu, etc.)
- Categorized site listings
- Drag and drop reordering
- Light/Dark mode support
- Local caching for fast load times
- Open-source and easily deployable via GitHub Pages

## Categories
- Common - Popular and frequently used sites
- Resources - Tools, utilities, and reference materials
- Forums - Discussion communities and boards
- Technology - Tech news, Linux, open-source, and infrastructure
- Development - Coding, documentation, and developer tools
- Servers - Hosting, VPS, and cloud platforms
- AI - Artificial intelligence tools and assistants
- Domains - Free domains, subdomains, and DNS services
- Email - Encrypted and privacy-focused email providers
- Cloud Storage - File storage and collaboration platforms

## Data Structure
The site uses a simple `public/data.json` file for configuration. Anyone can suggest adding a new site by opening an issue on the GitHub repository.
